entities.summary: Bernat Metge (Catalan pronunciation: [bəɾˈnad ˈmedʒə]; was a Catalan writer and humanist, best known as the author of The Dream of Bernat Metge, which he wrote from prison, in which Metge discusses the immortality of the soul.
